Stainless steel nails of heading 7318 (screws, bolts, nuts... ) are not the right fit, since nails of iron or steel are classified in 7317. Heading 7317.00: nails, tacks, drawing pins, corrugating nails, staples, of iron or steel, whether or not with heads of other material, but excluding those with heads of copper.

Subheadings under 7317.00:
- 7317.00.20 – Of one-piece construction, not collated... Actually, the structure is: 7317.00.10 is "Handmade nails" (not applicable), 7317.00.20 is "Staples in strips", 7317.00.30 is "Thumb tacks", and 7317.00.40 is "Nails, tacks, ... other: wire nails"? I recall that 7317.00.55 is "Other nails, of one-piece construction, ... not threaded", with 7317.00.5503 etc. for specific sizes, and 7317.00.65 is "Other: Other" with statistical suffixes.

Specifically:
- 7317.00.55: Other: Nails, tacks, drawing pins... of one-piece construction, round wire, not collated: 7317.00.5502 – Roofing nails; 503 – Nails, 5018 – Nails with a diameter 3.4 mm...? I recall 7317.00.5503 "Nails, of one-piece construction, round wire, not collated: Other nails, ... 7317.00.5505 – Hardened nails; 7317.00.5507 – Other nails: Of a length less than 3.8 cm? 7317.00.5508 – Roofing nails; 7317.00.5511 – Nails with a head diameter ≥..., 7317.00.5518 – Other, 7317.00.5519 – Other...

Stainless steel ring shank nails are probably 7317.00.5503 ("Having a shank with annular rings, other") or 7317.00.5560 for other. I recall 7317.00.5503 is "Nails: Having a shank diameter 3.4 mm or more..." and 7317.00.5707 is the bulk "Other: Of stainless steel"? I'll go with 7317.00.5502? I'm not certain; choose 7317.00.5503.
